panels.description: Foreman-7 orders Alex back while Tomas lies pinned beneath the frame. Leave upper worksite space.
Alex steps beyond the painted boundary; his band flashes the wage forfeiture. Leave upper display space.
Alex wedges a salvaged bracket beneath the frame while Tomas watches from below. Leave upper machinery space.
The frame lifts and Tomas pulls free. Alex remains under the load. Leave upper space for impact.

items.speaker: FOREMAN-7
items.text: Phantum. Return to your assigned zone.
LEAVING ASSIGNED ZONE — WAGE FORFEITED: −40 CR.
